sentences.text: Researchers used a mouse model of necrotizing enterocolitis to test the effects of beta-glucan treatment, finding that both low and high doses improved cognitive function in these animals.

The treatment fixed gut bacteria imbalances and increased levels of the metabolite indole-3-acetic acid, which protected the brain by activating a specific chain of cellular signaling proteins and restoring synaptic connections.
The authors state these results offer preclinical evidence that could help prevent long-term brain problems in human NEC survivors.
